title: Geometry-Agnostic Data-Driven Discovery of Extreme Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2610.28487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a two-stage data-driven neural framework for discovering dynamically admissible extreme scenarios. Rather than assuming prior knowledge of the governing equations, the first stage infers the effective dynamical constraints directly from observational data. When the underlying physical system possesses suitable symmetries, the learned dynamics can be represented in a geometry-agnostic form, independent of any fixed grid, coordinate system, dimensionality, and intrinsic curvature. In the second stage, a physics-informed neural-search uses this learned dynamics to uncover rare, high-impact coherent structures that may not have appeared in the original observations. We demonstrate this framework through representative examples of increasing dimensionality and geometric complexity. translated_title: 几何无关的数据驱动极端场景发现
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种两阶段的数据驱动神经框架，用于发现动力学上可容许的极端场景。该框架不假设预先掌握系统的控制方程，第一阶段直接从观测数据中推断有效的动力学约束。当底层物理系统具有适当的对称性时，所学到的动力学可以表示为一种几何无关的形式，独立于任何固定的网格、坐标系、维度和内在曲率。在第二阶段，一种物理信息引导的神经搜索利用所学到的动力学来揭示可能未在原始观测中出现过的稀有、高影响的相干结构。我们通过维度和几何复杂度不断增加的代表性示例演示了这一框架。从传统方法学习的Duffing动力学出发，我们发现了同宿脉冲这一合理的局域化极端场景。接下来，由于同一方程……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段数据驱动神经框架，无需预知控制方程即可从观测数据中学习几何无关的动力学约束，并通过物理信息神经搜索发现原始观测中未曾出现的稀有极端场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage data-driven neural framework that learns geometry-agnostic dynamical constraints directly from observational data without prior knowledge of governing equations, and uses physics-informed neural search to uncover rare extreme scenarios absent from the original observations.
